feature_gates.name: AdmissionWebhookMatchConditions
feature_gates.description: Enable match conditions on mutating & validating admission webhooks.

feature_gates.name: AggregatedDiscoveryEndpoint
feature_gates.description: Enable a single HTTP endpoint `/discovery/<version>` which supports native HTTP caching with ETags containing all APIResources known to the API server.

feature_gates.name: AllowDNSOnlyNodeCSR
feature_gates.description: Allow kubelet to request a certificate without any Node IP available, only with DNS names.

feature_gates.name: AllowInsecureKubeletCertificateSigningRequests
feature_gates.description: Disable node admission validation of CertificateSigningRequests for kubelet signers. Unless you disable this feature gate, Kubernetes enforces that new kubelet certificates have a `commonName` matching `system:node:$nodeName`.

feature_gates.name: AllowServiceLBStatusOnNonLB
feature_gates.description: Enables `.status.ingress.loadBalancer` to be set on Services of types other than `LoadBalancer`.

feature_gates.name: AnonymousAuthConfigurableEndpoints
feature_gates.description: Enable configuring anonymous authentication / authorization for only certain API server endpoints.

feature_gates.name: AnyVolumeDataSource
feature_gates.description: Enable use of any custom resource as the `DataSource` of a .

feature_gates.name: APIListChunking
feature_gates.description: Enable the API clients to retrieve (`LIST` or `GET`) resources from API server in chunks.

feature_gates.name: APIResponseCompression
feature_gates.description: Compress the API responses for `LIST` or `GET` requests.

feature_gates.name: APIServerIdentity
feature_gates.description: Assign each API server an ID in a cluster, using a Lease.

feature_gates.name: APIServerTracing
feature_gates.description: Add support for distributed tracing in the API server. See Traces for Kubernetes System Components for more details.

feature_gates.name: AppArmorFields
feature_gates.description: Enable AppArmor related security context settings. For more information about AppArmor and Kubernetes, read the AppArmor section within security features in the Linux kernel.

feature_gates.name: AppArmor
feature_gates.description: Enable use of AppArmor mandatory access control for Pods running on Linux nodes. See AppArmor Tutorial for more details.

feature_gates.name: AuthorizeNodeWithSelectors
feature_gates.description: Make the Node authorizer use fine-grained selector authorization. Requires `AuthorizeWithSelectors` to be enabled.

feature_gates.name: AuthorizeWithSelectors
feature_gates.description: Allows authorization to use field and label selectors. Enables `fieldSelector` and `labelSelector` fields in the SubjectAccessReview API, passes field and label selector information to authorization webhooks, enables `fieldSelector` and `labelSelector` functions in the authorizer CEL library, and enables checking `fieldSelector` and `labelSelector` fields in authorization webhook `matchConditions`.

feature_gates.name: CloudControllerManagerWebhook
feature_gates.description: Enable webhooks in cloud controller manager.

feature_gates.name: CloudDualStackNodeIPs
feature_gates.description: Enables dual-stack `kubelet --node-ip` with external cloud providers. See Configure IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack for more details.

feature_gates.name: ClusterTrustBundleProjection
feature_gates.description: `clusterTrustBundle` projected volume sources.

feature_gates.name: ClusterTrustBundle
feature_gates.description: Enable ClusterTrustBundle objects and kubelet integration.

feature_gates.name: ComponentSLIs
feature_gates.description: Enable the `/metrics/slis` endpoint on Kubernetes components like kubelet, kube-scheduler, kube-proxy, kube-controller-manager, cloud-controller-manager allowing you to scrape health check metrics.

feature_gates.name: ConcurrentWatchObjectDecode
feature_gates.description: Enable concurrent watch object decoding. This is to avoid starving the API server's watch cache when a conversion webhook is installed.

feature_gates.name: ConsistentListFromCache
feature_gates.description: Enhance Kubernetes API server performance by serving consistent **list** requests directly from its watch cache, improving scalability and response times. To consistent list from cache Kubernetes requires a newer etcd version (v3.4.31+ or v3.5.13+), that includes fixes to watch progress request feature. If older etcd version is provided Kubernetes will automatically detect it and fallback to serving consistent reads from etcd. Progress notifications ensure watch cache is consistent with etcd ...

feature_gates.name: ContainerCheckpoint
feature_gates.description: Enables the kubelet `checkpoint` API. See Kubelet Checkpoint API for more details.

feature_gates.name: ContextualLogging
feature_gates.description: Enables extra details in log output of Kubernetes components that support contextual logging.

feature_gates.name: CoordinatedLeaderElection
feature_gates.description: Enables the behaviors supporting the LeaseCandidate API, and also enables coordinated leader election for the Kubernetes control plane, deterministically.

feature_gates.name: CPUManagerPolicyAlphaOptions
feature_gates.description: This allows fine-tuning of CPUManager policies, experimental, Alpha-quality options This feature gate guards *a group* of CPUManager options whose quality level is alpha. This feature gate will never graduate to beta or stable.

feature_gates.name: CPUManagerPolicyBetaOptions
feature_gates.description: This allows fine-tuning of CPUManager policies, experimental, Beta-quality options This feature gate guards *a group* of CPUManager options whose quality level is beta. This feature gate will never graduate to stable.

feature_gates.name: CPUManagerPolicyOptions
feature_gates.description: Allow fine-tuning of CPUManager policies.

feature_gates.name: CPUManager
feature_gates.description: Enable container level CPU affinity support, see CPU Management Policies.

feature_gates.name: CRDValidationRatcheting
feature_gates.description: Enable updates to custom resources to contain violations of their OpenAPI schema if the offending portions of the resource update did not change. See Validation Ratcheting for more details.

feature_gates.name: CronJobsScheduledAnnotation
feature_gates.description: Set the scheduled job time as an on Jobs that were created on behalf of a CronJob.

feature_gates.name: CrossNamespaceVolumeDataSource
feature_gates.description: Enable the usage of cross namespace volume data source to allow you to specify a source namespace in the `dataSourceRef` field of a PersistentVolumeClaim.

feature_gates.name: CSIMigrationPortworx
feature_gates.description: Enables shims and translation logic to route volume operations from the Portworx in-tree plugin to Portworx CSI plugin. Requires Portworx CSI driver to be installed and configured in the cluster.

feature_gates.name: CSIVolumeHealth
feature_gates.description: Enable support for CSI volume health monitoring on node.

feature_gates.name: CustomCPUCFSQuotaPeriod
feature_gates.description: Enable nodes to change `cpuCFSQuotaPeriod` in kubelet config.

feature_gates.name: CustomResourceFieldSelectors
feature_gates.description: Enable `selectableFields` in the API to allow filtering of custom resource **list**, **watch** and **deletecollection** requests.

feature_gates.name: DefaultHostNetworkHostPortsInPodTemplates
feature_gates.description: This feature gate controls the point at which a default value for `.spec.containers[*].ports[*].hostPort` is assigned, for Pods using `hostNetwork: true`. The default since Kubernetes v1.28 is to only set a default value in Pods. Enabling this means a default will be assigned even to the `.spec` of an embedded PodTemplate (for example, in a Deployment), which is the way that older releases of Kubernetes worked. You should migrate your code so that it does not rely on the legacy behavior.

feature_gates.name: DevicePluginCDIDevices
feature_gates.description: Enable support to CDI device IDs in the Device Plugin API.

feature_gates.name: DisableAllocatorDualWrite
feature_gates.description: You can enable the `MultiCIDRServiceAllocator` feature gate. The API server supports migration from the old bitmap ClusterIP allocators to the new IPAddress allocators. The API server performs a dual-write on both allocators. This feature gate disables the dual write on the new Cluster IP allocators; you can enable this feature gate if you have completed the relevant stage of the migration.

feature_gates.name: DisableCloudProviders
feature_gates.description: Enabling this feature gate deactivated functionality in `kube-apiserver`, `kube-controller-manager` and `kubelet` that related to the `--cloud-provider` command line argument. In Kubernetes v1.31 and later, the only valid values for `--cloud-provider` are the empty string (no cloud provider integration), or "external" (integration via a separate cloud-controller-manager).

feature_gates.name: DisableKubeletCloudCredentialProviders
feature_gates.description: Enabling the feature gate deactivated the legacy in-tree functionality within the kubelet, that allowed the kubelet to to authenticate to a cloud provider container registry for container image pulls.

feature_gates.name: DisableNodeKubeProxyVersion
feature_gates.description: Disable setting the `kubeProxyVersion` field of the Node.

feature_gates.name: DRAControlPlaneController
feature_gates.description: Enables support for resources with custom parameters and a lifecycle that is independent of a Pod. Allocation of resources is handled by a resource driver's control plane controller.

feature_gates.name: DynamicProvisioningScheduling
feature_gates.description: Extend the default scheduler to be aware of volume topology and handle PV provisioning. This feature was superseded by the `VolumeScheduling` feature in v1.12.

feature_gates.name: DynamicResourceAllocation
feature_gates.description: Enables support for resources with custom parameters and a lifecycle that is independent of a Pod. Allocation of resources is handled by the Kubernetes scheduler based on "structured parameters".

feature_gates.name: EfficientWatchResumption
feature_gates.description: Allows for storage-originated bookmark (progress notify) events to be delivered to the users. This is only applied to watch operations.

feature_gates.name: ElasticIndexedJob
feature_gates.description: Enables Indexed Jobs to be scaled up or down by mutating both `spec.completions` and `spec.parallelism` together such that `spec.completions == spec.parallelism`. See docs on elastic Indexed Jobs for more details.

feature_gates.name: EventedPLEG
feature_gates.description: Enable support for the kubelet to receive container life cycle events from the via an extension to . (PLEG is an abbreviation for “Pod lifecycle event generator”). For this feature to be useful, you also need to enable support for container lifecycle events in each container runtime running in your cluster. If the container runtime does not announce support for container lifecycle events then the kubelet automatically switches to the legacy generic PLEG mechanism, even if you have this featur...

feature_gates.name: ExecProbeTimeout
feature_gates.description: Ensure kubelet respects exec probe timeouts. This feature gate exists in case any of your existing workloads depend on a now-corrected fault where Kubernetes ignored exec probe timeouts. See readiness probes.

feature_gates.name: GracefulNodeShutdownBasedOnPodPriority
feature_gates.description: Enables the kubelet to check Pod priorities when shutting down a node gracefully.

feature_gates.name: GracefulNodeShutdown
feature_gates.description: Enables support for graceful shutdown in kubelet. During a system shutdown, kubelet will attempt to detect the shutdown event and gracefully terminate pods running on the node. See Graceful Node Shutdown for more details.

feature_gates.name: HonorPVReclaimPolicy
feature_gates.description: Honor persistent volume reclaim policy when it is `Delete` irrespective of PV-PVC deletion ordering. For more details, check the PersistentVolume deletion protection finalizer documentation.

feature_gates.name: HPAContainerMetrics
feature_gates.description: Allow to scale based on metrics from individual containers within target pods.

feature_gates.name: HPAScaleToZero
feature_gates.description: Enables setting `minReplicas` to 0 for `HorizontalPodAutoscaler` resources when using custom or external metrics.

feature_gates.name: ImageMaximumGCAge
feature_gates.description: Enables the kubelet configuration field `imageMaximumGCAge`, allowing an administrator to specify the age after which an image will be garbage collected.

feature_gates.name: ImageVolume
feature_gates.description: Allow using the `image` volume source in a Pod. This volume source lets you mount a container image as a read-only volume.

feature_gates.name: InPlacePodVerticalScaling
feature_gates.description: Enables in-place Pod vertical scaling.

feature_gates.name: InTreePluginPortworxUnregister
feature_gates.description: Stops registering the Portworx in-tree plugin in kubelet and volume controllers.

feature_gates.name: JobBackoffLimitPerIndex
feature_gates.description: Allows specifying the maximal number of pod retries per index in Indexed jobs.

feature_gates.name: JobManagedBy
feature_gates.description: Allows to delegate reconciliation of a Job object to an external controller.

feature_gates.name: JobPodFailurePolicy
feature_gates.description: Allow users to specify handling of pod failures based on container exit codes and pod conditions.

feature_gates.name: JobPodReplacementPolicy
feature_gates.description: Allows you to specify pod replacement for terminating pods in a Job

feature_gates.name: JobSuccessPolicy
feature_gates.description: Allow users to specify when a Job can be declared as succeeded based on the set of succeeded pods.

feature_gates.name: KMSv1
feature_gates.description: Enables KMS v1 API for encryption at rest. See Using a KMS Provider for data encryption for more details.

feature_gates.name: KMSv2KDF
feature_gates.description: Enables KMS v2 to generate single use data encryption keys. See Using a KMS Provider for data encryption for more details. If the `KMSv2` feature gate is not enabled in your cluster, the value of the `KMSv2KDF` feature gate has no effect.

feature_gates.name: KMSv2
feature_gates.description: Enables KMS v2 API for encryption at rest. See Using a KMS Provider for data encryption for more details.

feature_gates.name: KubeProxyDrainingTerminatingNodes
feature_gates.description: Implement connection draining for terminating nodes for `externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster` services.

feature_gates.name: KubeletCgroupDriverFromCRI
feature_gates.description: Enable detection of the kubelet cgroup driver configuration option from the . You can use this feature gate on nodes with a kubelet that supports the feature gate and where there is a CRI container runtime that supports the `RuntimeConfig` CRI call. If both CRI and kubelet support this feature, the kubelet ignores the `cgroupDriver` configuration setting (or deprecated `--cgroup-driver` command line argument). If you enable this feature gate and the container runtime doesn't support it, the k...

feature_gates.name: KubeletInUserNamespace
feature_gates.description: Enables support for running kubelet in a . See Running Kubernetes Node Components as a Non-root User.

feature_gates.name: KubeletPodResourcesDynamicResources
feature_gates.description: Extend the kubelet's pod resources gRPC endpoint to to include resources allocated in `ResourceClaims` via `DynamicResourceAllocation` API. See resource allocation reporting for more details. with information about the allocatable resources, enabling clients to properly track the free compute resources on a node.

feature_gates.name: KubeletPodResourcesGet
feature_gates.description: Enable the `Get` gRPC endpoint on kubelet's for Pod resources. This API augments the resource allocation reporting.

feature_gates.name: KubeletSeparateDiskGC
feature_gates.description: The split image filesystem feature enables kubelet to perform garbage collection of images (read-only layers) and/or containers (writeable layers) deployed on separate filesystems.

feature_gates.name: KubeletTracing
feature_gates.description: Add support for distributed tracing in the kubelet. When enabled, kubelet CRI interface and authenticated http servers are instrumented to generate OpenTelemetry trace spans. See Traces for Kubernetes System Components for more details.

feature_gates.name: LegacyServiceAccountTokenCleanUp
feature_gates.description: Enable cleaning up Secret-based service account tokens when they are not used in a specified time (default to be one year).

feature_gates.name: LoadBalancerIPMode
feature_gates.description: Allows setting `ipMode` for Services where `type` is set to `LoadBalancer`. See Specifying IPMode of load balancer status for more information.

feature_gates.name: LocalStorageCapacityIsolationFSQuotaMonitoring
feature_gates.description: When `LocalStorageCapacityIsolation` is enabled for local ephemeral storage, the backing filesystem for emptyDir volumes supports project quotas, and `UserNamespacesSupport` is enabled, project quotas are used to monitor `emptyDir` volume storage consumption rather than using filesystem walk, ensuring better performance and accuracy.

feature_gates.name: LogarithmicScaleDown
feature_gates.description: Enable semi-random selection of pods to evict on controller scaledown based on logarithmic bucketing of pod timestamps.

feature_gates.name: LoggingAlphaOptions
feature_gates.description: Allow fine-tuning of experimental, alpha-quality logging options.

feature_gates.name: LoggingBetaOptions
feature_gates.description: Allow fine-tuning of experimental, beta-quality logging options.

feature_gates.name: MatchLabelKeysInPodAffinity
feature_gates.description: Enable the `matchLabelKeys` and `mismatchLabelKeys` fields for pod (anti)affinity.

feature_gates.name: MatchLabelKeysInPodTopologySpread
feature_gates.description: Enable the `matchLabelKeys` field for Pod topology spread constraints.

feature_gates.name: MaxUnavailableStatefulSet
feature_gates.description: Enables setting the `maxUnavailable` field for the rolling update strategy of a StatefulSet. The field specifies the maximum number of Pods that can be unavailable during the update.

feature_gates.name: MemoryManager
feature_gates.description: Allows setting memory affinity for a container based on NUMA topology.

feature_gates.name: MemoryQoS
feature_gates.description: Enable memory protection and usage throttle on pod / container using cgroup v2 memory controller.

feature_gates.name: MinDomainsInPodTopologySpread
feature_gates.description: Enable `minDomains` in Pod topology spread constraints.

feature_gates.name: MultiCIDRServiceAllocator
feature_gates.description: Track IP address allocations for Service cluster IPs using IPAddress objects.

feature_gates.name: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
feature_gates.description: In Kubernetes , this feature gate has no effect. A future release of Kubernetes may use this feature gate to enable the MutatingAdmissionPolicy in admission chain.

feature_gates.name: NewVolumeManagerReconstruction
feature_gates.description: Enables improved discovery of mounted volumes during kubelet startup. Since the associated code had been significantly refactored, Kubernetes versions 1.25 to 1.29 allowed you to opt-out in case the kubelet got stuck at the startup, or did not unmount volumes from terminated Pods. This refactoring was behind the `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod` feature gate in Kubernetes releases 1.25 and 1.26.

feature_gates.name: NFTablesProxyMode
feature_gates.description: Allow running kube-proxy in nftables mode.

feature_gates.name: NodeInclusionPolicyInPodTopologySpread
feature_gates.description: Enable using `nodeAffinityPolicy` and `nodeTaintsPolicy` in Pod topology spread constraints when calculating pod topology spread skew.

feature_gates.name: NodeLogQuery
feature_gates.description: Enables querying logs of node services using the `/logs` endpoint.

feature_gates.name: NodeOutOfServiceVolumeDetach
feature_gates.description: When a Node is marked out-of-service using the `node.kubernetes.io/out-of-service` taint, Pods on the node will be forcefully deleted if they can not tolerate this taint, and the volume detach operations for Pods terminating on the node will happen immediately. The deleted Pods can recover quickly on different nodes.

feature_gates.name: NodeSwap
feature_gates.description: Enable the kubelet to allocate swap memory for Kubernetes workloads on a node. Must be used with `KubeletConfiguration.failSwapOn` set to false. For more details, please see swap memory

feature_gates.name: OpenAPIEnums
feature_gates.description: Enables populating "enum" fields of OpenAPI schemas in the spec returned from the API server.

feature_gates.name: PDBUnhealthyPodEvictionPolicy
feature_gates.description: Enables the `unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy` field of a `PodDisruptionBudget`. This specifies when unhealthy pods should be considered for eviction. Please see Unhealthy Pod Eviction Policy for more details.

feature_gates.name: PersistentVolumeLastPhaseTransitionTime
feature_gates.description: Adds a new field to PersistentVolume which holds a timestamp of when the volume last transitioned its phase.

feature_gates.name: PodAndContainerStatsFromCRI
feature_gates.description: Configure the kubelet to gather container and pod stats from the CRI container runtime rather than gathering them from cAdvisor. As of 1.26, this also includes gathering metrics from CRI and emitting them over `/metrics/cadvisor` (rather than having cAdvisor emit them directly).

feature_gates.name: PodDeletionCost
feature_gates.description: Enable the Pod Deletion Cost feature which allows users to influence ReplicaSet downscaling order.

feature_gates.name: PodDisruptionConditions
feature_gates.description: Enables support for appending a dedicated pod condition indicating that the pod is being deleted due to a disruption.

feature_gates.name: PodHostIPs
feature_gates.description: Enable the `status.hostIPs` field for pods and the . The field lets you expose host IP addresses to workloads.

feature_gates.name: PodIndexLabel
feature_gates.description: Enables the Job controller and StatefulSet controller to add the pod index as a label when creating new pods. See Job completion mode docs and StatefulSet pod index label docs for more details.

feature_gates.name: PodLifecycleSleepAction
feature_gates.description: Enables the `sleep` action in Container lifecycle hooks.

feature_gates.name: PodReadyToStartContainersCondition
feature_gates.description: Enable the kubelet to mark the PodReadyToStartContainers condition on pods. This feature gate was previously known as `PodHasNetworkCondition`, and the associated condition was named `PodHasNetwork`.

feature_gates.name: PodSchedulingReadiness
feature_gates.description: Enable setting `schedulingGates` field to control a Pod's scheduling readiness.

feature_gates.name: PortForwardWebsockets
feature_gates.description: Allow WebSocket streaming of the portforward sub-protocol (`port-forward`) from clients requesting version v2 (`v2.portforward.k8s.io`) of the sub-protocol.

feature_gates.name: ProcMountType
feature_gates.description: Enables control over the type proc mounts for containers by setting the `procMount` field of a Pod's `securityContext`.

feature_gates.name: QOSReserved
feature_gates.description: Allows resource reservations at the QoS level preventing pods at lower QoS levels from bursting into resources requested at higher QoS levels (memory only for now).

feature_gates.name: RecoverVolumeExpansionFailure
feature_gates.description: Enables users to edit their PVCs to smaller sizes so as they can recover from previously issued volume expansion failures. See Recovering from Failure when Expanding Volumes for more details.

feature_gates.name: RecursiveReadOnlyMounts
feature_gates.description: Enables support for recursive read-only mounts. For more details, see read-only mounts.

feature_gates.name: RelaxedEnvironmentVariableValidation
feature_gates.description: Allow almost all printable ASCII characters in environment variables.

feature_gates.name: ReloadKubeletServerCertificateFile
feature_gates.description: Enable the kubelet TLS server to update its certificate if the specified certificate file are changed. This feature is useful when specifying `tlsCertFile` and `tlsPrivateKeyFile` in kubelet configuration. The feature gate has no effect for other cases such as using TLS boostrap.

feature_gates.name: RemainingItemCount
feature_gates.description: Allow the API servers to show a count of remaining items in the response to a chunking list request.

feature_gates.name: ResilientWatchCacheInitialization
feature_gates.description: Enables resilient watchcache initialization to avoid controlplane overload.

feature_gates.name: ResourceHealthStatus
feature_gates.description: Enable the `allocatedResourcesStatus` field within the `.status` for a Pod. The field reports additional details for each container in the Pod, with the health information for each device assigned to the Pod. See Device plugin and unhealthy devices for more details.

feature_gates.name: RetryGenerateName
feature_gates.description: Enables retrying of object creation when the is expected to generate a name. When this feature is enabled, requests using `generateName` are retried automatically in case the control plane detects a name conflict with an existing object, up to a limit of 8 total attempts.

feature_gates.name: RotateKubeletServerCertificate
feature_gates.description: Enable the rotation of the server TLS certificate on the kubelet. See kubelet configuration for more details.

feature_gates.name: RuntimeClassInImageCriApi
feature_gates.description: Enables images to be pulled based on the runtime class of the pods that reference them.

feature_gates.name: SchedulerQueueingHints
feature_gates.description: Enables the scheduler's _queueing hints_ enhancement, which benefits to reduce the useless requeueing. The scheduler retries scheduling pods if something changes in the cluster that could make the pod scheduled. Queueing hints are internal signals that allow the scheduler to filter the changes in the cluster that are relevant to the unscheduled pod, based on previous scheduling attempts.

feature_gates.name: SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod
feature_gates.description: Speeds up container startup by allowing kubelet to mount volumes for a Pod directly with the correct SELinux label instead of changing each file on the volumes recursively. The initial implementation focused on ReadWriteOncePod volumes.

feature_gates.name: SELinuxMount
feature_gates.description: Speeds up container startup by allowing kubelet to mount volumes for a Pod directly with the correct SELinux label instead of changing each file on the volumes recursively. It widens the performance improvements behind the `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod` feature gate by extending the implementation to all volumes. Enabling the `SELinuxMount` feature gate requires the feature gate `SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod` to be enabled.

feature_gates.name: SeparateTaintEvictionController
feature_gates.description: Enables running `TaintEvictionController`, that performs Taint-based Evictions, in a controller separated from `NodeLifecycleController`. When this feature is enabled, users can optionally disable Taint-based Eviction setting the `--controllers=-taint-eviction-controller` flag on the `kube-controller-manager`.

feature_gates.name: ServerSideApply
feature_gates.description: Enables the Sever Side Apply (SSA) feature on the API Server.

feature_gates.name: ServerSideFieldValidation
feature_gates.description: Enables server-side field validation. This means the validation of resource schema is performed at the API server side rather than the client side (for example, the `kubectl create` or `kubectl apply` command line).

feature_gates.name: ServiceAccountTokenJTI
feature_gates.description: Controls whether JTIs (UUIDs) are embedded into generated service account tokens, and whether these JTIs are recorded into the Kubernetes audit log for future requests made by these tokens.

feature_gates.name: ServiceAccountTokenNodeBindingValidation
feature_gates.description: Controls whether the apiserver will validate a Node reference in service account tokens.

feature_gates.name: ServiceAccountTokenNodeBinding
feature_gates.description: Controls whether the API server allows binding service account tokens to Node objects.

feature_gates.name: ServiceAccountTokenPodNodeInfo
feature_gates.description: Controls whether the apiserver embeds the node name and uid for the associated node when issuing service account tokens bound to Pod objects.

feature_gates.name: ServiceTrafficDistribution
feature_gates.description: Allows usage of the optional `spec.trafficDistribution` field in Services. The field offers a way to express preferences for how traffic is distributed to Service endpoints.

feature_gates.name: SidecarContainers
feature_gates.description: Allow setting the `restartPolicy` of an init container to `Always` so that the container becomes a sidecar container (restartable init containers). See Sidecar containers and restartPolicy for more details.

feature_gates.name: SizeMemoryBackedVolumes
feature_gates.description: Enable kubelets to determine the size limit for memory-backed volumes (mainly `emptyDir` volumes).

feature_gates.name: StableLoadBalancerNodeSet
feature_gates.description: Enables less load balancer re-configurations by the service controller (KCCM) as an effect of changing node state.

feature_gates.name: StatefulSetAutoDeletePVC
feature_gates.description: Allows the use of the optional `.spec.persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy` field, providing control over the deletion of PVCs in a StatefulSet's lifecycle. See PersistentVolumeClaim retention for more details.

feature_gates.name: StatefulSetStartOrdinal
feature_gates.description: Allow configuration of the start ordinal in a StatefulSet. See Start ordinal for more details.

feature_gates.name: StorageVersionAPI
feature_gates.description: Enable the storage version API.

feature_gates.name: StorageVersionHash
feature_gates.description: Allow API servers to expose the storage version hash in the discovery.

feature_gates.name: StorageVersionMigrator
feature_gates.description: Enables storage version migration. See Migrate Kubernetes Objects Using Storage Version Migration for more details.

feature_gates.name: StrictCostEnforcementForVAP
feature_gates.description: Apply strict CEL cost validation for ValidatingAdmissionPolicies.

feature_gates.name: StrictCostEnforcementForWebhooks
feature_gates.description: Apply strict CEL cost validation for `matchConditions` within admission webhooks.

feature_gates.name: StructuredAuthenticationConfiguration
feature_gates.description: Enable structured authentication configuration for the API server.

feature_gates.name: StructuredAuthorizationConfiguration
feature_gates.description: Enable structured authorization configuration, so that cluster administrators can specify more than one authorization webhook in the API server handler chain.

feature_gates.name: SupplementalGroupsPolicy
feature_gates.description: Enables support for fine-grained SupplementalGroups control. For more details, see Configure fine-grained SupplementalGroups control for a Pod.

feature_gates.name: TopologyAwareHints
feature_gates.description: Enables topology aware routing based on topology hints in EndpointSlices. See Topology Aware Hints for more details.

feature_gates.name: TopologyManagerPolicyAlphaOptions
feature_gates.description: Allow fine-tuning of topology manager policies, experimental, Alpha-quality options. This feature gate guards *a group* of topology manager options whose quality level is alpha. This feature gate will never graduate to beta or stable.

feature_gates.name: TopologyManagerPolicyBetaOptions
feature_gates.description: Allow fine-tuning of topology manager policies, experimental, Beta-quality options. This feature gate guards *a group* of topology manager options whose quality level is beta. This feature gate will never graduate to stable.

feature_gates.name: TopologyManagerPolicyOptions
feature_gates.description: Enable fine-tuning of topology manager policies.

feature_gates.name: TranslateStreamCloseWebsocketRequests
feature_gates.description: Allow WebSocket streaming of the remote command sub-protocol (`exec`, `cp`, `attach`) from clients requesting version 5 (v5) of the sub-protocol.

feature_gates.name: UnauthenticatedHTTP2DOSMitigation
feature_gates.description: Enables HTTP/2 Denial of Service (DoS) mitigations for unauthenticated clients. Kubernetes v1.28.0 through v1.28.2 do not include this feature gate.

feature_gates.name: UnknownVersionInteroperabilityProxy
feature_gates.description: Proxy resource requests to the correct peer kube-apiserver when multiple kube-apiservers exist at varied versions. See Mixed version proxy for more information.

feature_gates.name: UserNamespacesPodSecurityStandards
feature_gates.description: Enable Pod Security Standards policies relaxation for pods that run with namespaces. You must set the value of this feature gate consistently across all nodes in your cluster, and you must also enable `UserNamespacesSupport` to use this feature.

feature_gates.name: UserNamespacesSupport
feature_gates.description: Enable user namespace support for Pods.

feature_gates.name: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
feature_gates.description: Enable ValidatingAdmissionPolicy support for CEL validations be used in Admission Control.

feature_gates.name: VolumeAttributesClass
feature_gates.description: Enable support for VolumeAttributesClasses. See Volume Attributes Classes for more information.

feature_gates.name: VolumeCapacityPriority
feature_gates.description: Enable support for prioritizing nodes in different topologies based on available PV capacity.

feature_gates.name: WatchBookmark
feature_gates.description: Enable support for watch bookmark events.

feature_gates.name: WatchCacheInitializationPostStartHook
feature_gates.description: Enables post-start-hook for watchcache initialization to be part of readyz (with timeout).

feature_gates.name: WatchFromStorageWithoutResourceVersion
feature_gates.description: Enables watches without `resourceVersion` to be served from storage.

feature_gates.name: WatchList
feature_gates.description: Enable support for streaming initial state of objects in watch requests.

feature_gates.name: WinDSR
feature_gates.description: Allows kube-proxy to create DSR loadbalancers for Windows.

feature_gates.name: WinOverlay
feature_gates.description: Allows kube-proxy to run in overlay mode for Windows.

feature_gates.name: WindowsHostNetwork
feature_gates.description: Enables support for joining Windows containers to a hosts' network namespace.

feature_gates.name: ZeroLimitedNominalConcurrencyShares
feature_gates.description: Allow priority & fairness in the API server to use a zero value for the `nominalConcurrencyShares` field of the `limited` section of a priority level.
